killedBy: arenaSchematic draws the same cover the simulation builds, not a second grid walk
arenaSchematic keeps every rectangle inside the floor it reports
why: An AABB's far edge used as a width -- the single most available slip when flattening `{minX, maxX}` into `{x, w}`, and the one that still draws something board-shaped. Every rectangle grows rightward to its own right edge again, so cover smears across the board and the card stops describing the arena; but the card still renders, the canvas still fills, and every structural assertion about the card (a canvas exists, it has a box, it is aria-hidden) passes. jsdom has no 2D context, so no HUD test can see a pixel of it either. Killed only by the two cases that compare the rectangles against `wallsForQuery`'s own AABBs and check each one stays inside the reported floor.
